title: Ukusukelana Kwasenkundleni
intro: Kwiindlela zamandla, umntu ohloniphekileyo wachukumiseka yisicaka esasinobuhle obungafaniyo nobehlabathi. Olu thando lwakhokelela kuthotho lweziganeko ezaziza kuvavanya ukuthembeka, zityhile iinyaniso ezifihlakeleyo, kwaye ekugqibeleni ziqinisekise ukuba isicaka asinatyala.
clues: Ndandihlala kwilizwe loMlambo iNayile, kwibhotwe elalinempembelelo enkulu.
Inkwenkwe ethile yangena endlwini yam, kwaye ubukho bayo bandenza ndaphazamiseka.
Ndazama ukumcenga, kodwa wafuna indawo yokusabela eNkosini yakhe.
Ndakrazula ingubo yakhe ngasemva, kodwa ubungqina babonisa ukuba ndingumntu okhohlisayo.
Ukuze ndithule intlebendwane yabafazi abadumileyo, ndabamema kwindibano ndaza ndababeka izinto ezibukhali ezandleni zabo.
Ekugqibeleni, ndavuma esidlangalaleni ityala lam, ndivuma inyaniso phambi kokumkani.

arabic: قَالَ مَا خَطْبُكُنَّ إِذْ رَٰوَدتُّنَّ يُوسُفَ عَن نَّفْسِهِۦ ۚ قُلْنَ حَـٰشَ لِلَّهِ مَا عَلِمْنَا عَلَيْهِ مِن سُوٓءٍۢ ۚ قَالَتِ ٱمْرَأَتُ ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلْـَٔـٰنَ حَصْحَصَ ٱلْحَقُّ أَنَا۠ رَٰوَدتُّهُۥ عَن نَّفْسِهِۦ وَإِنَّهُۥ لَمِنَ ٱلصَّـٰدِقِينَ
verse: Said [the king to the women], "What was your condition when you sought to seduce Joseph?" They said, "Perfect is Allāh! We know about him no evil." The wife of al-ʿAzeez said, "Now the truth has become evident. It was I who sought to seduce him, and indeed, he is of the truthful. (12:51)
